title: A ticket with a landed dependency does not join a group whose branch lacks main
objective: A ready ticket with a landed dependency joins an open group only when main is an ancestor of that group's branch; otherwise it waits.
outline: devloop/ticket_controller.py only: one helper (for example has_main(group) returning self.repo.is_ancestor(self.cfg.main_branch, 'refs/heads/' + group['branch'])) used by joinable() and by group_for() for the open group it chose. group_for has its own dependency loop and is what dispatch uses; advance_groups uses joinable; the rule must hold in both. No README change.
test_plan: Verifier: acceptance 4 and 5 in one new class T<id>Acceptance in tests_devloop/test_devloop.py placed directly after class GroupSizeUnits (before class NoReverifyPaths). Build the layout the way FollowMainUnits does (its commit_on, group and ctl helpers; copy what you need, do not subclass it - that re-runs its cases): self.add(1, state='landed'); self.add(2, deps=[1]); self.add(3, state='running' or 'merged', group='g1', target='int/g1'); branch int/g1 from main; group g1 open with members ['3']; commit shared.txt on int/g1 and on main; ctl.advance_groups(self.snap()); then read joinable / group_for / the group's state from a fresh snapshot. Strip every DEVLOOP_* variable from self.env and os.environ in setUp (FollowMainUnits.setUp). Implementer's own unit tests (placed directly after class FollowMainUnits, before class NoReverifyRule): acceptance 3, and that after a clean main merge (main an ancestor of int/g1) joinable stays True and group_for returns 'g1'.
notes: Measured on f50b578 with the layout of acceptance 4: after advance_groups g1 is open with main_tried set, is_ancestor(main, int/g1) is False, joinable(snap, '2', g1) is True and group_for(snap, '2') is 'g1'; with #3 merged, g1 stays 'open'. Why members are exempt: a ready member (back from an interrupt) keeps its open group open; if it could not rejoin, the group would wait for it forever. Expected flow after the change (inferred): the group becomes pr, its main-moved path merges main (the fixer on a conflict), and the waiting ticket gets a new group from main at the next dispatch. Why it waits rather than opening a new group while the old one is open: the request says it waits.
acceptance: Controller.joinable(snap, ident, group) is False when ident is not in group['members'], at least one of ident's dependencies is 'landed', and main (cfg.main_branch) is not an ancestor of refs/heads/<group['branch']>, checked with one git call (Git.is_ancestor); in every other case it decides as today.
Controller.group_for(snap, ident) returns None (joins no group, opens none) when the open group it picks fails that check for ident; when the check passes the result is as today.
No git call is made when ident is already a member of that group or has no landed dependency (a Controller built without a repo, as in GroupSizeUnits, keeps working).

Layout: #1 landed; #2 ready, depends on #1; open group g1 with member #3 running; int/g1 and main both changed shared.txt (int/g1 'group\n', main 'main\n'); after ctl.advance_groups(snap) (main's merge conflicted, main_tried set): joinable(snap, '2', g1) is False and group_for(snap, '2') is None.
Same layout with #3 merged instead of running: advance_groups moves g1 from 'open' to 'pr'.
token_basis: about 10 lines in ticket_controller.py; verifier: 2 git-level cases under 1 s each. Includes cache reads. No per-ticket token rows survive (the pool restarted at #100), so this is inferred from docs/HANDOFF.md dollar totals (g16+g17: 13 tickets ~37 USD; g18+g19: 3 tickets ~18.6 USD), i.e. roughly 3-6 USD per ticket; every agent that opens tests_devloop/test_devloop.py (19k lines) pays for the part it reads.
vision: VISION metrics 一次就過測試的比例 (up) and 每張落地票的 token 與時間 (down): a ticket started on a branch that lacks its landed dependency (follow_main leaves the branch without main on a conflict) works against code that is not there and fails its rounds (inferred).
removes: none: it makes the existing dependency rule (landed, or merged in the same branch) hold for the branch actually used; no gate or step is added
request:
# Rounds count only real reds; pages that reach the user; quota words; small board fixes

Reported by T (the tabby project) after weeks on devloop; the main session checked each against the code at f50b578 and asked a second model to judge the designs for simplicity. No new role, no new state; one optional config key (devloop.notify). Read docs/DECISIONS.md (do not edit it).

1. A round counts only when the code was red (T measured: #137, #282, #286, #287 stuck ~20 h; read here). Today a round that ends because merging the latest int/gN into t/N conflicts (ticket_issuer.integrate, the "merge it yourself" feedback) or because a cases_wrong revision threw out the verifier's cases (THROWN_OUT) costs one of max_rounds. Rule: those two exits mark their feedback event free (e.g. free=true on the event); the round loop counts rounds minus free rounds against max_rounds, with a hard cap of 2 x max_rounds rounds in total; t.round keeps counting every round (logs and prompts use it). A red after taking in the target (cases fail) still counts. The next round's worker resolves the conflict as today (no merge agent). The stuck page says how many of its rounds were real reds and how many were free (merge conflict / revision), counted from those events.

2. devloop.notify (optional string, default null): a shell command run from pool.report (one place) for each new decision, env or idle page, detached, output appended to <worktrees>/runs/notify.log, failure ignored, never blocking the caller; the page's kind, subject and first line in env vars (DEVLOOP_PAGE_KIND, DEVLOOP_PAGE_SUBJECT, DEVLOOP_PAGE_TEXT) and its file path in DEVLOOP_PAGE. Documented with a macOS notification example and a phone push example. actl doctor checks its type. Purpose: pages waited 11-20 h because no main session was open.

3. Quota words (measured here: _says_quota returns False for '429 ... usage_limit_reached' and 'rate_limit_error'). Normalise '_' to ' ' in the text before matching QUOTA_SIGNS, and use the same normalised text in _excerpt. Do not add '429' as a sign (logs hold many 429s). Test with those two strings.

4. Opener out of quota (T measured twice: the page said no valid tickets). The opener runs in the foreground of `actl new`, so it must not wait hours for a reset. When its run's cost row says out of quota, do not try a second attempt; the page and stdout say: out of quota, the excerpt and the reset time if readable, send the request again after it.

5. joinable(): a ticket with a landed dependency may join an open group only when main is an ancestor of the group's branch (one git call); otherwise it waits (follow_main leaves a branch without main when merging main conflicted). Test with a group whose main merge conflicted.

6. Board: the 知道了 (ack) action with text in the box is refused by act_problem with a line telling to use 照我的話改 / 帶著我的話重驗 instead (today the text is silently dropped).

7. Release-failed page: name the last 'devloop-stage:' step the release printed and the last ~15 lines of its log. Move the board's live_release_step / live_tail helpers to a shared core module used by the board, ticket_controller's release page and tickets.py release, instead of writing them twice. The page claims nothing about production; a project's release script prints that itself.
